# Dōbutsu no Mori e+ PC/Android port v1.5.2

Version 1.5.2 of the port that runs [afe-decomp](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-decomp) (the どうぶつの森 e+ decompilation) on PC and Android.

## Changes since v1.5.1

**Your house no longer disappears after a trip by train, and a town that lost buildings gets them back.** With
seamless acres (on by default since v1.4.13) the buildings of the acres around you are live actors, and while each
one is, the game keeps a placeholder where it stands in the town's data. The game's own saves to the memory card (the
station master's before a train trip, the gyroid's, a new town's first save) copied the town with those
placeholders, so the file lost the buildings around you: after a trip by train, a multiplayer visit included, a
player's house and mailbox on the plaza (and whatever else was near the station) were gone at home. Every save now
writes the buildings themselves. A town file that already lost some is mended when it loads (the log says
`[PC] town repaired: ...`): the players' houses and mailboxes, the gyroids, Nook's shop, the station, the post office
and the other buildings of the town's original layout, the villagers' houses with their signboards and the signs of
empty lots go back where they stood. What was inside the houses (furniture, the loan, the rooms' size) was never
lost, only the building outside, so a mended house is as it was.

**In multiplayer, guests see the host's shop, station and houses.** The host's own placeholders went to guests with
the town and with item updates, so a guest saw no Nook's shop (or station, post office, houses, mailboxes) wherever
the host had those buildings as actors, and could not go in. Placeholders are never sent or taken now, either way: a
guest gets the host's buildings, and a guest's game keeps its own.

**More of the host's town is the same for everyone in a room**, as it would be for one player:

- the day's visitors are where the host's are (Gulliver on the beach, Joan, Wendell, Pascal...): each game picked its
  own spots from its own clock;
- what a guest does with a visitor (buying from Redd in his tent, from Gracie or Saharah, a gift taken), a fish caught
  for the fishing tourney and a snowman built go to the host and everyone;
- a change a guest makes just before leaving a place (a purchase, a post on the board) is no longer lost, nor are
  changes in the first seconds after the host's data came;
- the board's automatic notices are the host's alone (a guest's game also posted its own on the host's board);
- with seamless acres, the host's villagers in the acres beside a guest are out there for the guest too, not only
  those in the guest's own acre;
- a snowman or a ball near one player no longer vanishes for the others (its actor taking it out of the ground was
  sent as if it had been picked up), and a guest can no longer drop or take an item on a unit where the host has a
  building's actor or is busy with it (an item falling, a hole being dug).

**A trip is safe when the room closes.** If the room closed or the host sent a guest out while the guest was on its
trip (from the station's save to the way home), the port gave memory card slot B back to the real card at once, while
the game was still in the copy of the host's town; the train home then wrote the host's town to the guest's real card
B, over any town there. Slot B now stays on the copy until the guest is home, and the guest gets home as usual. A
villager who was moving out of the guest's town no longer moves into that copy (which is thrown away, so the villager
was gone from both towns); it stays, still moving out. A guest whose own town is on card B, or whose town has the
same name and number as the host's, is told that it cannot go instead of the station mixing the towns up.

- Signed with the same key as the previous version, so it installs over it (saves, the Korean patch and texture
  packs are kept).

## Updating

- **From v1.0.0 or later**, the game finds this version when it starts and offers to update (**Update now**; on
  Android, **업데이트** in the dialog). If GitHub answers with an error, try again a little later.
- v0.1.6 and earlier cannot update themselves: install this version by hand once.
- **Multiplayer needs v1.5.2 for everyone in a room**: the room's messages changed (protocol 4). Rooms of v1.4.0 to
  v1.5.1 show as "other version" in the room list of v1.5.2 and the other way round, and joining one by its code is
  refused as another version. 32-bit and 64-bit players can still play together, whatever graphics API each uses.

## Read this first

- **No game data is included.** You need your own disc image of the Japanese 「どうぶつの森 e+」 **Rev 1 (GAEJ01)**
  (`.iso` / `.ciso` / `.gcm`) to run it. Disc images are not distributed.
- **To play in Korean**, download the Korean patch from [retrodb 한글패치 — 동물의 숲 e+](https://retrodb.info/krpatch/7428/%EB%8F%99%EB%AC%BC%EC%9D%98-%EC%88%B2-e)
  and apply it in the game (pause menu → Settings → Disc → Korean patch → Install...). The Korean patch is the work of an
  independent author (역전맞고) unrelated to this repository.
- Multiplayer: [README](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/blob/main/README.md#multiplayer). For players from
  other networks, the surest way is UPnP turned on in the host's router, or UDP 47070 forwarded to the host's device.

## Verified

Played by script on two games in one container, a host and a guest (the guest's town and the host's town are
different files), and on single towns:

- **A trip by train and back**: the guest joins, rides to the host's town and takes the train home. Its town file then
  has all 12 buildings of its plaza (houses, mailboxes, gyroids) and differs from the file before the trip only by the
  day's changes (a tree that grew, a new weed); nothing was written to its real card B. The copy of the host's town
  it was given is the host's town unit for unit; in the same run, the copy v1.5.1 gives had placeholders where two of
  the host's lot signs stand.
- **The room closed while the guest was in the host's town**: the guest took the train home as usual, slot B went
  back to the real card only once it was home, nothing was written to card B, and its town file kept its plaza.
- **A guest by the host's shop**, the host standing next to it: the guest sees Nook's shop and the host.
- **Villagers beside a guest**: the host in an acre with two villagers out, the guest at the station (diagonally
  beside it) and then in the next acre: the guest's game brought both out where the host's walk; v1.5.1 only brought
  out those in the guest's own acre.
- **A town file damaged by v1.5.1** (a trip had taken the 12 buildings of its plaza, two villagers' houses with their
  signboards, two lot signs and the dump): all 19 came back when it loaded, and the towns that were not damaged got
  no repair.
- An independent review of the change found five problems, fixed before this release: the repair could put a lot sign
  where a damaged villager's house stood (the house's unit is its lot's); a passing train could reach a guest's copy
  of the town; an item a guest put down on a unit the host was busy with stayed on the guest's ground after being
  refused; the visitors' spots took the guest's own state of an event with them (Gracie's car, K.K., the tourney,
  the Wisp); and a room joined during another trip never sent its town. Testing also found the unit before a
  villager's door kept in saved towns (harmless, as the house empties it again), now saved empty.
- The 43 scripted scenarios run for every release give the same screenshots, logged positions and saves on v1.5.1
  and on this version (921 screenshots), seamless acres off as in every release before.
- All unit tests pass; the decomp change is inside `TARGET_PC` only and the matching build's hashes are unchanged.
- Android: the release-key signature (certificate `db6fc1ad…`) and the version (1.5.2, versionCode 10502); the four
  files hold the same files as v1.5.1's.

## Known limitations

- Two players in the same shop at once each see the stock as it was when they came in until the other's purchase
  arrives (about a second), so both can buy the last of an item.
- What the host's villagers remember of a guest (talks, gifts, letters) stays in the guest's copy of the host's town,
  which is thrown away at the end of the trip. The island (its villager, items and weather) is still each player's
  own.
- The limitations of v1.5.0 remain (Vulkan and Direct3D 12 checked on software renderers only; see its
  [release notes](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/releases/tag/v1.5.0)), and those of
  [v1.4.3](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/releases/tag/v1.4.3).

Build instructions and detailed progress are in [docs/README.md](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/blob/main/docs/README.md).
